buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build' --preview-run 'ci:ensurePreviewOrganization'; else npm run build; fi

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://vercel.live; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://*.convex.cloud wss://*.convex.cloud https://vercel.live; frame-ancestors 'none';
